marketLayer.title: US Tech & Semiconductors
marketLayer.fact: Major US cloud hyperscalers reported a 25% year-over-year increase in quarterly AI infrastructure expenditure, with cloud revenue growth accelerating past 28%.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high capital expenditure reinforces strong order visibility for advanced semiconductor suppliers and optical networking vendors across the US tech supply chain.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential delays in consumer-facing AI application monetization relative to mounting hardware depreciation costs.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet & E-Commerce Sector
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index advanced as key Chinese e-commerce platforms reported stabilized merchant take-rates and double-digit growth in cross-border logistics volume.
marketLayer.inference: Domestic price competition is being increasingly offset by fast-growing overseas revenue channels and cost optimization, stabilizing sector profit margins.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Fluctuations in domestic consumer confidence metrics and evolving trade regulatory hurdles in overseas expansion regions.

marketLayer.title: Global Macro & US Monetary Policy
marketLayer.fact: US core PCE inflation met consensus expectations at 2.6% year-over-year, alongside a slight increase in initial jobless claims.
marketLayer.inference: The macro background reinforces market pricing for an upcoming Federal Reserve rate cut, easing liquidity conditions and supporting capital inflows into HK equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Re-acceleration of service inflation driven by wage pressures or supply-chain shocks from geopolitical tensions.
